profile: AtriCure develops surgical treatments and therapies for atrial fibrillation, left atrial appendage management, and post-operative pain. Its cardiac ablation and appendage-management products are used by physicians in open-heart and minimally invasive procedures. CryoICE cryoSPHERE and cryoXT probes provide temporary nerve-block pain relief after cardiac, thoracic, and amputation surgeries. AtriCure sells to medical centers directly and through distributors.
